# Getting started with Pantry

Pantry keeps your household's shopping lists in one place. Make a list for
each kind of shop, add what you need, tick things off as you buy them, and
share a list with the people you shop with.

## Signing in

Open Pantry in your browser and sign in with your email address and your
password. Pantry doesn't have a sign-up page: whoever runs Pantry for your
household creates your account and tells you your password. See
[Your account](accounts.md) for more.

Once you're in, you land on **Your lists**.

## Your first list

1. On **Your lists**, type a name under **New list** — "Weekend", say.
2. Press **Create list**. Pantry opens the new list.
3. Under **Item**, type what you need, set the **Quantity**, and press
   **Add item**.

That's it. Add as many items as you like; [Items](items.md) explains the rest.

## Shopping

Take Pantry with you to the shop. As you put something in the basket, press
**Mark bought** next to it: it's crossed out, and the count beside the list's
name goes down by one. When the count says **0 to buy**, you're done.

## Shopping together

If someone else in your household shops too, share the list with them and
you'll both see the same items, ticked or not. See [Sharing a list](sharing.md).

## Signing out

Press **Sign out** at the top of any page. On a shared computer, always sign
out when you're finished.
